entry.title: Bvlgari Presents Passing the Light | Diwali 2026

media:group.media:title: Bvlgari Presents Passing the Light | Diwali 2026
media:group.media:description:
From earth to finished form, from one generation to the next.
Passing the Light follows the transformation of terracotta in the hands of Indian artisans, culminating in an installation of 4,500 elements inspired by traditional diyas. Created for Diwali by Bvlgari in collaboration with artist Doyel Joshi, the kumhar community and local craftswomen, the film celebrates the gestures, discipline and knowledge that connect craftsmanship across cultures.
#Bvlgari

entry.title: Bvlgari Talks with Gislain Aucremanne: The 1973 Sautoir at Bvlgari Kaleidos Shanghai.

media:group.media:title: Bvlgari Talks with Gislain Aucremanne: The 1973 Sautoir at Bvlgari Kaleidos Shanghai.
media:group.media:description:
From Rome to Shanghai, color becomes a bridge between cultures. Heritage Curator Gislain Aucremanne unveils the story behind an extraordinary 1973 Bvlgari sautoir, crafted in gold with coral, onyx and diamonds and crowned by an engraved jade medallion.
Presented to the public for the first time at Bvlgari Kaleidos: Colors, Cultures and Crafts in Shanghai, the creation embodies the Maison’s bold chromatic language and its enduring dialogue between East and West.
Discover the exhibition at the Power Station of Art in Shanghai from September 5 to October 31, 2026.
#Bvlgari #Kaleidos

entry.title: Bvlgari | Serpenti Infinito’s auruBOROS is more than meets the eye

media:group.media:title: Bvlgari | Serpenti Infinito’s auruBOROS is more than meets the eye
media:group.media:description:
Conceived by artist duo Yena Young and Marco Canevacci of Plastique Fantastique, auruBOROS, Urban Memory and Collective Dream transforms the High Line into a fleeting space for reflection and imagination.
Its mirrored golden surface does more than reflect New York. It bends and reframes it, inviting the public to walk around, touch and experience the city from a different perspective. More than an installation, auruBOROS becomes a temporary relationship between the city and those who encounter it.
On view at the High Line at Little West 12th Street from September 10–20.
#Bvlgari #SerpentiInfinitoNY

entry.title: Bvlgari | Serpenti Infinito's Monumental Installation auruBOROS

media:group.media:title: Bvlgari | Serpenti Infinito's Monumental Installation auruBOROS
media:group.media:description:
A monumental form in gold rises from beneath the pavement of New York’s High Line. Bvlgari’s first public art installation in the United States, auruBOROS — Urban Memory and Collective Dream, makes its grand debut, conceived by artist duo Plastique Fantastique for Serpenti Infinito.
Transforming the iconic urban landscape into an open-air stage, this immersive installation brings together contemporary art, urban memory and the enduring symbolism of Serpenti.
#Bvlgari #SerpentiInfinitoNY
